title: Anthropic 7 founders worth $141 billion vs. Elon Musk's $900 billion
excerpt: Anthropic's seven founders are worth $141 billion combined after its IPO. Elon Musk's $900 billion fortune is more than six times larger.
content_html:
Anthropic's founders are really wealthy. How far behind Elon Musk are they?

By Alistair Barr

You're currently following this author! Click to unsubscribe from email alerts.

Author of the AI Insider newsletter

2026-11-22T12:18:01.271Z

It's a very good week to be a founder of Anthropic.

The AI lab went public at $83 a share on Thursday, making its seven cofounders worth about $20 billion apiece, based on the IPO price.

The richest probably isn't even CEO Dario Amodei. It could be Tom Brown, Anthropic's relatively little-known chief compute officer, whose roughly 244 million shares are worth $20.3 billion.

Amodei's stake is worth about $20 billion. His sister Daniela, Anthropic's president, is worth roughly the same. Jack Clark, a former colleague of mine, is worth about that much, too.
